metadata.name: checkpoint.commit
metadata.description: Checkpoint channel. =checkpoint("name") formulas enqueue {checkpoint:true, name}; the drain snapshots user-space into the ring.

metadata.name: checkpoint.drain
metadata.description: (items) - take dehydrate snapshots for enqueued checkpoint requests; ring capped at 20.

metadata.name: checkpoint
metadata.description: (name) - vocabulary head: value is a checkpoint request; the channel drain takes the snapshot.

metadata.name: checkpoint.snapshot
metadata.description: (state, name) - imperative snapshot (gestures/drains call this directly).

metadata.name: checkpoint.restore
metadata.description: (state, name?) - DISPATCHED ONLY: wipe non-kernel user-space, rehydrate the named (or latest) snapshot, precompute, cycle.

metadata.name: checkpoint.delta
metadata.description: (state, from, to?) - {added, removed, changed} cel keys between two snapshots, or snapshot vs live when to omitted.

metadata.name: checkpoint.ring
metadata.description: The in-memory snapshot ring. Segment 'kernel' ON PURPOSE (the errors-log precedent): dehydrate excludes it (snapshots never nest into snapshots) and restore's wipe keeps it (the ring survives its own restores).
